text.title: FreshDrop reminder, concierge test with 10 buyers, August 2026
text.hypothesis: if a buyer gets a reminder before the slot, then missed slots fall, which the share of kept slots will confirm, because our data shows misses
text.need: a buyer needs a fixed slot; the test is a manual slot booking by chat
text.approach: Concierge: the team books the slots by hand for 10 buyers
text.behind: ops books the slot, the courier is told by the app team; the log is a shared sheet
text.group: 10 buyers from Moscow, chosen from the survey, 14 days
text.result: 9 of 10 kept their slot; 2 asked for the evening slot; ops spent 25 minutes per order
text.decision: automate the reminder first; stop the manual slot booking after 1 month
